label.stepHint.bloom: Pour gently to wet all the grounds, then wait for the gas to escape.
label.stepHint.pour: Pour slowly in circles, from the centre outwards.
label.stepHint.stir: Stir gently so the grounds and water mix evenly.
label.stepHint.swirl: Swirl the brewer gently to level the bed.
label.stepHint.extract: Start the pump with the timer; stop when the shot reaches its target weight.
label.stepHint.drawdown: Wait until all the water has drained, then tap “Finish”.
label.stepHint.removeFromHeat: Remove when it starts to hiss; cool the base in cold water to stop extraction.
label.stepHint.filter: Strain the grounds out of the coffee.

advice.diagnosis.espressoFast: Espresso ran too fast (under 20 seconds) — the grind is too coarse
advice.diagnosis.espressoSlow: Espresso ran too slow (over 35 seconds) — the grind is too fine
advice.diagnosis.uneven: Both sour and bitter — uneven extraction (channelling)
advice.diagnosis.underExtracted: Sharp sourness, thin, short finish — under-extracted
advice.diagnosis.tooWeak: Balanced, but weak and watery — too dilute
advice.diagnosis.tooStrong: Balanced, but heavy and intense — too strong
advice.diagnosis.best: Delicious! A high score and nothing to fix
advice.diagnosis.balanced: No problems to correct so far
advice.diagnosis.needTasting: Not enough tasting notes to diagnose yet
advice.noAdjustment: No suggestion is possible right now (e.g. no grinder or grind setting was given, or the setting is at the end of the scale) — try adjusting one thing at a time yourself.
advice.keep.best: Keep this recipe — you can star it as the “best recipe” for these beans.
advice.keep.balanced: Keep the recipe — add taste notes (sour / bitter / body) for more precise advice, or change one thing at a time if you want a higher score.
advice.note.beanTooFresh: The beans are very fresh and may still be gassy — let them rest first.
advice.note.beanStale: The aroma may have faded — try slightly hotter water.
advice.adj.ratioStronger: Make it stronger: {from} → {to} (coffee {dose} g : water {water} g)

advice.adj.techniqueEspresso: Adjust technique: distribute the grounds and tamp evenly.
